build_TopKTopPSampler: build a TopKTopPSampler module that applies top-k and top-p filtering then samples from logits
run_apply_top_k_top_p: run top-k and top-p filtering on logits tensor with optional k and p thresholds
test_random_sample: test random sampling from probability distribution using Gumbel-max trick instead of multinomial
review_flashinfer_sample: review flashinfer-based top-k/top-p sampling that avoids sorting via rejection sampling
summarize_apply_top_k_only: summarize top-k masking that avoids full vocab sorting using GPU topk for efficiency
